description: Returns one property and the permission level this credential has on it. Useful for settling which of the two spellings exists — "sc-domain:example.com" and "https://example.com/" are separate properties holding separate data.

site_url.description: The Search Console property: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or "https://example.com/" for a URL-prefix property (the trailing slash is required)

title: Get one property
